title: You “won” a student award
scenario: A polished email says you were selected for a youth scholarship and must upload a student ID plus pay a $15 processing fee to accept. It names your school and grade correctly.

answers.A: Pay the small fee because the email already knows your school details.
answers.B: Verify the scholarship through the organization’s official site and your school counselor before sending ID or money.
answers.C: Ask the organization to explain why a winner must pay a fee and provide formal terms.

explanation: School details can be public or scraped. Legitimate awards should be independently verifiable before money or identity documents move.
proTip: Winning should not start with paying.
